Test Case Description: Valid admin login
Test Steps:
1. Open http://localhost:5173/login
2. Enter a whitelisted admin email and correct password
3. Click Log In
Expected Result: User is authenticated, JWT issued, and redirected to /dashboard

Test Case Description: Invalid password
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter a whitelisted email with the wrong password
3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login rejected with error "Invalid credentials"; user stays on login page

Test Case Description: Non-whitelisted email
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter an email not on the admin whitelist
3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login rejected with error "Access Denied: Unauthorized Admin Account"

Test Case Description: Empty email and/or password
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Leave email and/or password blank
3. Click Log In
Expected Result: Validation error "Email and password required"; form does not submit

Test Case Description: Account lockout after repeated failed attempts
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter a valid email with an incorrect password
3. Repeat step 2 until the lockout threshold is reached
4. Attempt to log in again immediately
Expected Result: Account temporarily locked; error "Account temporarily locked after failed sign-in attempts. Try again later."

Test Case Description: Password login on a Google-only account
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter the email of an account created via Google Sign-In
3. Enter any password
4. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login rejected with error "Use Google Login for this account"
